statistic.name: other
statistic.notes: Inventory scores (climate change content knowledge) significantly predicted undergraduates' climate change risk perception, while cultural worldviews and political orientation did not.

sample.description: Undergraduates in an introductory Earth science course.

source.citation: Aksit, O., McNeal, K. S., Gold, A. U., Libarkin, J. C., & Harris, S. (2018). The influence of instruction, prior knowledge, and values on climate change risk perception among undergraduates. Journal of Research in Science Teaching, 55(4), 550-572.
